_comment: Paired recipe-knob env for the otr_16gb_ltx_video preset (video-tiers). ltx23_high_video is the display id of the EXISTING ltx_video / eng_ltx_video two-stage HQ engine (unchanged; its internal x2 latent upscaler stays active); OTR_ENABLE_LTX_VIDEO is that engine's PRE-EXISTING enable flag (NOT a new gate). The retired ltx23_16gb_video spelling still resolves via _LEGACY_ENGINE_ALIASES. A launcher CLEARS the prior-tier key set, exports these, then boots + loads workflows/otr_canonical.json + applies the profile in memory (never this preset as the workflow). Silent output; OTR_MasterAudioMux muxes the OTR master audio afterward. NOTE the preset id still says 16gb: it is a PROFILE filename, not a public engine id, and renaming it would move a committed variant path for no behavioural gain.
